messages:
maya: We're kicking off a staggered recertification for admin entitlements next week. Goal: reduce admin counts by ~20% without disrupting Dedicated or Private customers. Outline below.

maya: Plan: 1) Snapshot current admins & svc accts (KMS key admins included). 2) Automatic 7-day notice to owners. 3) 2-week grace window. 4) Rolling revocations by team to avoid blast radius.

eric: Makes sense. How do you want to treat cross-account roles and temporary elevation tokens?

maya: Keep ephemeral elevations (just-in-time) out of revocation; we'll flag them for evidence. For cross-account roles, owners must approve in each acct. We'll add a `do-not-touch` tag for critical keys.

olivia: Do we have audit-log proof that KMS admins were active in the last 90 days? I can run a query.

maya: Yes please. Example query we'll run for initial filtering:

```sql
SELECT principal, key_id, max(event_time) AS last_use
FROM kms_audit.events
GROUP BY principal, key_id
HAVING max(event_time) < now() - interval '90 days';
```

olivia: I'll run that and drop results into the shared spreadsheet. Heads-up: keys used by infra-backed svc-accts might show as inactive due to cached creds; we should cross-check with infra owners before any revokes.

paul: For the revocation job, how do we avoid breaking long-lived callbacks? Can we do a dry-run to list potentially impacted infra deploys?

maya: Yes — dry-run mode first. We have a deploy hook that rejects revokes if a liveness check fails for a dependent service. Plan: canary wave 1 = non-prod teams, wave 2 = low-risk prod, wave 3 = high-risk prod after manual approval.

devsec-bot: Audit job scheduled: recertification-staggered v1 queued for 2026-04-01T09:00Z. Report will be posted to #eng-security.

eric: Also, add a manual override for SRE oncall to pause runs during incidents. We don't want auto-revokes mid-response.

maya: Good call — adding `--pause-during-oncall` flag and an oncall API endpoint to pause/resume.

olivia: Can we add a smoke test that attempts a read-only KMS decrypt with the svc-acct before revoking? If it fails, route to infra owners instead of auto-removal.

maya: Yup — smoke decrypt + deploy liveness + owner approval OR escalate to security for manual review. We'll include a short evidence pack (last 90d usage, recent deploys, owner comment) in each ticket.

paul: Sounds safe. :thumbsup:

maya: If nobody objects by EOD Friday I'll create the jobs and schedule the first canary for 2026-04-01. Thanks all.
